hook.en: A balance sheet full of errors, or one that reaches you two years late, does not help anyone. Good accounting information must have certain qualities.

say.en: A balance sheet full of errors, or one that reaches you two years late, does not help anyone. Good accounting information must have certain qualities. In this lesson: State the four qualitative characteristics.
Explain each with an example.

body.en: Reliable information is verifiable from source documents, free from error and bias, and faithfully shows the facts. Relevant information reaches users in time and helps them predict the future or confirm past expectations. Both are needed for a sound decision.
body.kn: ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ: ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಬಹುದಾದ, ದೋಷ ಮತ್ತು ಪಕ್ಷಪಾತ ರಹಿತವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು. ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ: ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಸಿಗಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಹಾಯಕವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು.

title.kn: ಹೋಲಿಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಅದೇ ವಿಧಾನ

narration.en: Information is comparable only when it is prepared the same way each year. Switching the depreciation method in year 2 adds a paper profit, so the reported growth is not the real growth. Set real growth to 0% and switch the method. What growth is reported? Can a fall in profit look like a rise? Try a negative growth.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಒಂದೇ ರೀತಿ ತಯಾರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಹೋಲಿಕೆಗೆ ಯೋಗ್ಯ. ವರ್ಷ 2ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸವಕಳಿ ವಿಧಾನ ಬದಲಿಸಿದರೆ ಕಾಗದದ ಲಾಭ ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆ; ವರದಿಯ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ನಿಜವಾದ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲ. ನಿಜ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ 0% ಮಾಡಿ ವಿಧಾನ ಬದಲಿಸಿ. ಎಷ್ಟು ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ವರದಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ? ಲಾಭದ ಇಳಿಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯಂತೆ ಕಾಣಬಹುದೇ? ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ.

title.en: On the board: Four qualities of useful information

say.en: Reliable information can be checked against vouchers and is free from bias.
Relevant information reaches users in time and helps them predict or confirm.
Understandable information can be grasped by a user with reasonable knowledge.
Comparable information uses the same methods, so we compare years and firms.
Now spot the missing quality in each case.
On the board: Four qualities of useful information.

prompt.en: Each statement describes good accounting information. Sort it under the qualitative characteristic it shows.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಅದು ತೋರಿಸುವ ಗುಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಲಕ್ಷಣದ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

text.en: Every figure can be checked against a bill or voucher
Stock is valued without any personal bias
The report reaches the bank before it decides on the loan
The figures help to predict next year's sales
Technical terms are explained in simple notes
Statements follow a clear, familiar layout
The same depreciation method is used every year
The firm's results can be set beside others in its industry

explanation.en: Reliable information is verifiable and free from bias; relevant information is timely and helps prediction; understandable information is clearly presented; comparable information uses the same methods over time and across firms.

problem.en: Which quality is missing? (a) Annual accounts of a firm are released 18 months late. (b) A firm changes its stock valuation method every year. (c) Sales figures cannot be traced to any invoice.

steps.en: (a) The information is not timely, so it lacks relevance.
(b) Changing methods every year makes years impossible to compare, so comparability is lost.
(c) Figures that cannot be verified from source documents lack reliability.

a The information is not timely, so it lacks relevance.
b Changing methods every year makes years impossible to compare, so comparability is lost.
c Figures that cannot be verified from source documents lack reliability.
So the answer is a Relevance, b Comparability, c Reliability.
